translations.translation: 一(个) 每一(个)

sentence_examples.en: I bought a book.
sentence_examples.zh: 我买了一本书。

sentence_examples.en: She is a teacher.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是一位老师。

sentence_examples.en: There is a cat on the roof.
sentence_examples.zh: 屋顶上有一只猫。

translations.translation: 丢弃 放弃 抛弃
放纵

sentence_examples.en: People sometimes abandon a plan if it's no longer feasible.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果计划不再可行，人们有时会放弃它。

sentence_examples.en: The city decided to abandon the old bridge project.
sentence_examples.zh: 该市决定放弃这项旧桥项目。

sentence_examples.en: She danced with abandon.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在跳舞时毫无约束地放纵自己。

translations.translation: 能力 能耐 本领

sentence_examples.en: Her ability to solve problems impressed the team.
sentence_examples.zh: 她解决问题的能力让团队印象深刻。

sentence_examples.en: Learning a new language can improve your ability to communicate.
sentence_examples.zh: 学习一门新语言可以提高你的沟通能力。

sentence_examples.en: This sport tests your physical ability and endurance.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项运动考验你的体能和耐力。

translations.translation: 能干的 有能力的 出色的

sentence_examples.en: She is able to finish the task on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 她能够按时完成任务。

sentence_examples.en: He is able to speak five languages.
sentence_examples.zh: 他能说五种语言。

sentence_examples.en: With practice, you will be able to perform better.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过练习，你将能够表现得更好。

translations.translation: 反常的 不正常的 不规则的 变态的
不正常的人

sentence_examples.en: The test results were abnormal, so the doctor ordered a second opinion.
sentence_examples.zh: 检查结果异常，因此医生建议他寻求第二意见。

sentence_examples.en: It is abnormal for a healthy adult to sleep so little every night.
sentence_examples.zh: 健康成年人每晚睡这么少是反常的。

sentence_examples.en: The patient showed abnormal behavior after the medication, therefore requiring further tests.
sentence_examples.zh: 服药后，患者出现异常行为，因此需要进行进一步检查。

translations.translation: 在船(车)上 在火车上 在飞机上
上船 上飞机 上车

sentence_examples.en: All aboard—the train is leaving in five minutes.
sentence_examples.zh: 请上车——火车还有五分钟就要出发。

sentence_examples.en: We went aboard the ship at noon.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们中午登上了那艘船。

sentence_examples.en: Passengers aboard the plane were asked to fasten their seat belts.
sentence_examples.zh: 登机的乘客被要求系好安全带。

translations.translation: 关于 在周围
准备
大约

sentence_examples.en: We talked about the new policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们讨论了新政策。

sentence_examples.en: The team is about to start the match.
sentence_examples.zh: 球队就要开始比赛了。

sentence_examples.en: There were about fifty attendees.
sentence_examples.zh: 大约有五十名与会者。

translations.translation: 在上面 超过 高于
上面的
在上面 超过
上面的东西

sentence_examples.en: The sun was shining above the trees.
sentence_examples.zh: 太阳在树木上方照耀着。

sentence_examples.en: The picture above the sofa is new.
sentence_examples.zh: 沙发上方的那幅画是新的。

sentence_examples.en: Prices rose above expectations this quarter.
sentence_examples.zh: 本季度价格超出预期。

translations.translation: (在)国外 海外(一般作表语) 到处 到国外 广为流传

sentence_examples.en: She studied abroad for a semester.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在国外留学一个学期。

sentence_examples.en: There are many opportunities abroad.
sentence_examples.zh: 海外有很多机会。

sentence_examples.en: News about the festival spread abroad quickly.
sentence_examples.zh: 关于这个节日的消息很快传到了海外。

translations.translation: 缺席 不在场 缺乏

sentence_examples.en: Her absence from the meeting was noted by the organizers.
sentence_examples.zh: 主办方注意到了她缺席这次会议。

sentence_examples.en: There is an absence of evidence to support the claim.
sentence_examples.zh: 没有证据支持这一说法。

sentence_examples.en: The absence of the key player weakened the team.
sentence_examples.zh: 关键球员的缺席削弱了球队。

translations.translation: 缺席的 不在场的 缺乏的
使缺席
没有

sentence_examples.en: She was absent from the meeting due to a doctor's appointment.
sentence_examples.zh: 她因医生的预约而缺席了会议。

sentence_examples.en: The key ingredient is absent from the recipe.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个配方中缺少一个关键配料。

sentence_examples.en: He absented himself from the ceremony.
sentence_examples.zh: 他主动缺席了仪式。

translations.translation: 绝对的 纯粹的 完全的 无限制的 独立的 专制的
绝对的事物

sentence_examples.en: The president has absolute power over the state.
sentence_examples.zh: 总统对国家拥有绝对权力。

sentence_examples.en: She spoke with absolute certainty about her findings.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对自己的发现充满了绝对的确定性。

sentence_examples.en: The absolute value of -7 is 7.
sentence_examples.zh: -7 的绝对值是 7。

translations.translation: 独立地 完全地 绝对地

sentence_examples.en: I absolutely agree with you.
sentence_examples.zh: 我完全同意你的看法。

sentence_examples.en: It is absolutely necessary to wear a helmet.
sentence_examples.zh: 佩戴头盔是绝对必要的。

sentence_examples.en: This restaurant is absolutely fantastic.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家餐厅绝对棒极了。

translations.translation: 吸收 吸纳 吸引的注意 吞并 使专心

sentence_examples.en: Sponges absorb water quickly.
sentence_examples.zh: 海绵会迅速吸收水分。

sentence_examples.en: The keynote speech absorbed the audience's attention.
sentence_examples.zh: 主题演讲吸引了全场观众的注意力。

sentence_examples.en: The company absorbed a smaller rival.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司吞并了一家较小的对手。

translations.translation: 抽象的 理论的
摘要 抽象的东西
移除 摘要 偷
做摘要

sentence_examples.en: The concept of time is abstract.
sentence_examples.zh: 时间的概念是抽象的。

sentence_examples.en: The abstract of the article summarizes the study.
sentence_examples.zh: 这篇文章的摘要概括了研究内容。

sentence_examples.en: Researchers abstracted the key findings from the data.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员从数据中提取了关键发现。

translations.translation: 丰富的 充裕的 大量的

sentence_examples.en: There is abundant evidence to support the theory.
sentence_examples.zh: 有充足的证据支持这一理论。

sentence_examples.en: The region has abundant water resources.
sentence_examples.zh: 该地区拥有丰富的水资源。

sentence_examples.en: Abundant sunshine helps plants grow.
sentence_examples.zh: 充足的日照有助于植物生长。

translations.translation: 滥用 辱骂 虐待
滥用 恶习

sentence_examples.en: If you abuse drugs, you risk serious health problems.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你滥用药物，你将面临严重的健康问题。

sentence_examples.en: There is growing concern about the abuse of power by officials.
sentence_examples.zh: 人们越来越担心官员滥用权力。

sentence_examples.en: The charity helps victims of abuse.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个慈善机构帮助遭受虐待的人。

translations.translation: 学院的 理论的 学术性的
教学人员 学术人员

sentence_examples.en: Her academic achievements earned her a scholarship.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在学术方面的成就为她赢得了奖学金。

sentence_examples.en: This university emphasizes academic rigor in its programs.
sentence_examples.zh: 这所大学的课程强调学术严谨。

sentence_examples.en: An academic from the physics department gave a lecture on quantum theory.
sentence_examples.zh: 物理系的一位学者就量子理论作了讲座。

translations.translation: 私立中学 专科院校 学院 学术 学会

sentence_examples.en: The academy offers programs in computer science and engineering.
sentence_examples.zh: 这所学院提供计算机科学与工程课程。

sentence_examples.en: She transferred to a prestigious academy to study biology.
sentence_examples.zh: 她转入一所知名学院学习生物学。

sentence_examples.en: The Academy announced new guidelines for research ethics.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学院宣布了关于研究伦理的新准则。

translations.translation: (使)加快 促进 加速 提前 跳级
加速

sentence_examples.en: The company plans to accelerate its production schedule to meet demand.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司计划加速生产进度以满足需求。

sentence_examples.en: A higher temperature will accelerate the chemical reaction.
sentence_examples.zh: 更高的温度会加速化学反应。

sentence_examples.en: Regular exercise can help accelerate your recovery after an injury.
sentence_examples.zh: 规律的锻炼可以帮助你在受伤后加速康复。

translations.translation: 加速 促进 加速度

sentence_examples.en: The car's acceleration from 0 to 60 mph was impressive.
sentence_examples.zh: 这辆车从0到60英里/小时的加速令人印象深刻。

sentence_examples.en: In physics class, acceleration is defined as the rate of change of velocity.
sentence_examples.zh: 在物理课上，加速度被定义为速度变化的速率。

sentence_examples.en: There has been an acceleration in population growth over the last decade.
sentence_examples.zh: 在过去十年里，人口增长出现了加速。

translations.translation: 口音 腔调 重音 强调
重读 强调

sentence_examples.en: She has a thick French accent.
sentence_examples.zh: 她说话带着浓厚的法语口音。

sentence_examples.en: The speaker accented the final syllable to stress the word.
sentence_examples.zh: 演讲者把最后一个音节重读以强调这个词。

sentence_examples.en: Your accent can reveal where you’re from.
sentence_examples.zh: 你的口音能透露你来自哪里。

translations.translation: 接受 同意 承担(责任等)
接受

sentence_examples.en: She accepted the invitation to the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 她接受了参加派对的邀请。

sentence_examples.en: Please accept my apology for the delay.
sentence_examples.zh: 请接受我因延迟而致的道歉。

sentence_examples.en: They accepted the offer and signed the contract.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们接受了这份报价并签署了合同。

translations.translation: 可接受的 合意的 受欢迎的

sentence_examples.en: The manager said the proposal was acceptable.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理说这个提案可接受。

sentence_examples.en: It's acceptable to arrive a few minutes early.
sentence_examples.zh: 提前几分钟到达是可以接受的。

sentence_examples.en: Her suggestion is acceptable and could work well.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的建议是可以接受的，可能会起作用。

translations.translation: 接受（礼物、邀请、建议等） 同意 认可 验收 承认

sentence_examples.en: Her acceptance of the job offer surprised her family.
sentence_examples.zh: 她接受了这份工作邀请，令家人感到惊讶。

sentence_examples.en: The committee's acceptance of the proposal came after weeks of review.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过数周的审查，委员会接受了该提案。

sentence_examples.en: Their parents finally gave their acceptance of the marriage.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们的父母最终同意了他们的婚事。

translations.translation: 进入 接近(的机会) 使用之权 通道 入口
(电脑)存取 进入

sentence_examples.en: Access to the secure area requires an employee badge.
sentence_examples.zh: 进入安全区域需要员工胸卡。

sentence_examples.en: The website provides easy access to training materials.
sentence_examples.zh: 该网站让用户便捷地访问培训材料。

sentence_examples.en: You can access your email from any device.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以在任何设备上访问你的邮箱。

translations.translation: 同谋 从犯 附件
附属的(副的、辅助的)

sentence_examples.en: He was charged as an accessory to the burglary.
sentence_examples.zh: 他因成为入室盗窃案的从犯而被起诉。

sentence_examples.en: She wore a hat as an accessory to her outfit.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把帽子作为她穿搭的配饰。

sentence_examples.en: The device has an accessory port for connecting peripherals.
sentence_examples.zh: 该设备有一个辅助端口，用于连接外设。

translations.translation: 意外的 事故

sentence_examples.en: There was a small accident on the highway this morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 今早在高速公路上发生了一起小事故。

sentence_examples.en: Accidents can happen if you drive in poor weather.
sentence_examples.zh: 天气恶劣时驾驶，事故就可能发生。

sentence_examples.en: She almost had an accident while cycling.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在骑车时差点儿发生事故。

translations.translation: 意外的 偶然的 附属的 非本质的
偶然 不重要的东西 <音>变调的临时符号

sentence_examples.en: The damage was accidental.
sentence_examples.zh: 损坏是意外造成的。

sentence_examples.en: Her discovery of the solution was accidental.
sentence_examples.zh: 她发现这个解法是偶然的。

sentence_examples.en: In music, an accidental is a symbol that raises or lowers a note.
sentence_examples.zh: 在乐谱中，变音记号是一种改变音高的符号。

translations.translation: 容纳 供应 供给 提供方便 使一致 和解 顾及
使自己适应

sentence_examples.en: The hotel can accommodate up to 200 guests.
sentence_examples.zh: 酒店最多可以容纳200位客人。

sentence_examples.en: We will do our best to accommodate your schedule.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们会尽力配合您的日程安排。

sentence_examples.en: The plan aims to accommodate both sides' concerns.
sentence_examples.zh: 该计划旨在兼顾双方的关切。

translations.translation: 招待设备 预定铺位 住处 膳宿 适应 和解

sentence_examples.en: We booked accommodation near the conference center.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在会议中心附近订了住宿。

sentence_examples.en: The university provides exam accommodations for students with disabilities.
sentence_examples.zh: 学校为有需要的学生在考试中提供便利措施。

sentence_examples.en: We reached an accommodation with the landlord to resolve the rent dispute.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们与房东就房租纠纷达成了一项和解。

translations.translation: 陪伴 陪同 伴随 给伴奏
伴奏

sentence_examples.en: She will accompany me to the doctor's appointment.
sentence_examples.zh: 她会陪我去看医生。

sentence_examples.en: The singer was accompanied by a pianist.
sentence_examples.zh: 歌手由钢琴师伴奏。

sentence_examples.en: I asked my friend to accompany me to the concert.
sentence_examples.zh: 我请朋友陪我去音乐会。

translations.translation: 达到(目的) 完成

sentence_examples.en: She worked hard to accomplish her goal before the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 她努力工作，在截止日期前实现了目标。

sentence_examples.en: The project was finally accomplished after months of planning.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过数月的规划，该项目最终完成了。

sentence_examples.en: She accomplished a lot in her first year at the company.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在公司第一年取得了许多成就。

translations.translation: 使一致 调解 赠予 给予
一致 调和 协议 自愿
(与)一致

sentence_examples.en: The two sides signed a peace accord.
sentence_examples.zh: 双方签署了一项和平协议。

sentence_examples.en: The university accorded him an honorary degree.
sentence_examples.zh: 大学授予他荣誉学位。

sentence_examples.en: This decision accords with our plans.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个决定符合我们的计划。

translations.translation: 一致 和谐 授予 符合 同意

sentence_examples.en: The policy was implemented in accordance with government guidelines.
sentence_examples.zh: 该政策是按照政府指引实施的。

sentence_examples.en: All payments must be made in accordance with the contract.
sentence_examples.zh: 所有付款必须按照合同执行。

sentence_examples.en: The report was prepared in accordance with the agreed methodology.
sentence_examples.zh: 该报告按双方同意的方法编写。

translations.translation: 因此 所以 于是 相应地 照着

sentence_examples.en: The country reduced emissions, and accordingly, the company shifted to renewable energy.
sentence_examples.zh: 国家减排，因此公司转向了可再生能源。

sentence_examples.en: If the study shows positive results, we will implement the plan accordingly.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果研究结果显示积极，我们将据此实施该计划。

sentence_examples.en: Sales dropped last quarter; accordingly, we tightened the budget.
sentence_examples.zh: 上个季度销售额下降，因此我们收紧了预算。

translations.translation: 记述 解释 根据 理由 帐目 报告 估计 利益 好处
报账 解释 导致
把视为 归咎(于)

sentence_examples.en: She gave a detailed account of what happened.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对发生的事情作了详细的记述。

sentence_examples.en: The missing funds are difficult to account for.
sentence_examples.zh: 难以解释这笔丢失资金的原因。

sentence_examples.en: I opened a new bank account.
sentence_examples.zh: 我开了一个新的银行账户。

translations.translation: 积累 累加 堆积
堆积 累积

sentence_examples.en: Over the years, debt can accumulate if you don't budget.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果不做预算，债务会逐渐积累。

sentence_examples.en: Dust tends to accumulate in the corners of the room.
sentence_examples.zh: 房间的角落往往会积累灰尘。

sentence_examples.en: She is trying to accumulate enough points to win the prize.
sentence_examples.zh: 她正在努力积累足够的积分以赢得奖品。

translations.translation: 准确(性) 准确度

sentence_examples.en: The accuracy of the GPS data is within 5 meters.
sentence_examples.zh: GPS数据的准确性在5米之内。

sentence_examples.en: We need to verify the accuracy of the measurements before publishing results.
sentence_examples.zh: 在发布结果之前，我们需要核实这些测量的准确性。

sentence_examples.en: Accuracy improves with more training data.
sentence_examples.zh: 随着训练数据增多，准确性会提高。

translations.translation: 准确的 正确无误的

sentence_examples.en: The data is accurate and supports the conclusion.
sentence_examples.zh: 数据是准确的，支持结论。

sentence_examples.en: Please ensure your measurements are accurate.
sentence_examples.zh: 请确保你的测量结果准确无误。

sentence_examples.en: Her calculations were accurate.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的计算很准确。

translations.translation: 指责 责备 控告 归咎于

sentence_examples.en: He quickly accused his colleague of stealing the idea.
sentence_examples.zh: 他很快指控同事窃取了他的点子。

sentence_examples.en: Don't accuse me without proof.
sentence_examples.zh: 没有证据就不要指控我。

sentence_examples.en: The report accuses the company of polluting the river.
sentence_examples.zh: 该报告指控该公司污染了河流。

translations.translation: 使习惯

sentence_examples.en: The coach tried to accustom the players to a stricter routine.
sentence_examples.zh: 教练设法让队员适应更严格的训练日程。

sentence_examples.en: It took her several weeks to accustom herself to the new environment.
sentence_examples.zh: 她花了好几周的时间来适应新环境。

sentence_examples.en: Parents gradually accustom children to regular sleep and meal times.
sentence_examples.zh: 父母会逐步让孩子习惯规律的作息和用餐时间。

translations.translation: 惯常的 习惯的

sentence_examples.en: I am accustomed to waking up before dawn.
sentence_examples.zh: 我习惯在拂晓前起床。

sentence_examples.en: After living in the city for years, he is accustomed to the noise.
sentence_examples.zh: 在城市里住了多年后，他已经习惯了喧闹的声音。

sentence_examples.en: The staff are accustomed to handling difficult customers.
sentence_examples.zh: 员工们已经习惯处理难对付的顾客。

translations.translation: 痛 想念 渴望
疼痛

sentence_examples.en: My feet ache after walking all day.
sentence_examples.zh: 我走了一整天后脚很疼。

sentence_examples.en: She aches to see her family.
sentence_examples.zh: 她渴望见到家人。

sentence_examples.en: The ache in my back woke me up.
sentence_examples.zh: 背部的痛把我弄醒了。

translations.translation: 完成 实现 达到
达到目的

sentence_examples.en: She worked hard to achieve her dream of becoming a doctor.
sentence_examples.zh: 她努力工作，以实现成为医生的梦想。

sentence_examples.en: The team finally achieved its goal after months of effort.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过数月的努力，团队最终实现了目标。

sentence_examples.en: Small steps can help you achieve your objectives.
sentence_examples.zh: 一些小步骤可以帮助你实现目标。

translations.translation: 完成 成就 成绩 达到

sentence_examples.en: Winning the championship was a huge achievement.
sentence_examples.zh: 赢得冠军是一项巨大的成就。

sentence_examples.en: Completing the project ahead of schedule was a notable achievement for the team.
sentence_examples.zh: 提前完成项目对团队来说是一个显著的成就。

sentence_examples.en: Her latest achievement in technology earned her a promotion.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在科技领域的最新成就为她带来了晋升。

translations.translation: 酸 酸味物质
酸的 酸性的

sentence_examples.en: Citric acid is found in citrus fruits.
sentence_examples.zh: 柠檬酸存在于柑橘类水果中。

sentence_examples.en: Stomach acid helps digestion.
sentence_examples.zh: 胃酸有助于消化。

sentence_examples.en: A battery contains sulfuric acid.
sentence_examples.zh: 电池中含有硫酸。

translations.translation: 认识 了解 熟人

sentence_examples.en: I bumped into an acquaintance at the park.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在公园遇到了一个熟人。

sentence_examples.en: An acquaintance of mine gave me some useful career advice.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的一个熟人给了我一些有用的职业建议。

sentence_examples.en: It's hard to tell an acquaintance from a close friend.
sentence_examples.zh: 很难分辨熟人和密友。

translations.translation: 占有 取得 获得 学到

sentence_examples.en: She managed to acquire a new language after living abroad.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在国外生活一段时间后，设法学会了一门新语言。

sentence_examples.en: The company acquired several startups to expand its market.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司收购了几家初创公司以扩大市场。

sentence_examples.en: Over time, he acquired the habit of reading before bed.
sentence_examples.zh: 他逐渐养成了睡前读书的习惯。

sentence_examples.en: The farm covers 100 acres.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个农场占地100英亩。

sentence_examples.en: They donated an acre of land for the park.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们为公园捐出了一英亩土地。

sentence_examples.en: A house sits on about an acre.
sentence_examples.zh: 一栋房子坐落在大约一英亩的土地上。

translations.translation: 横过 穿过 在对面
横过 使被理解(或接受)

sentence_examples.en: She walked across the street to reach the store.
sentence_examples.zh: 她穿过街道去商店。

sentence_examples.en: There is a café across from my apartment.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的公寓对面有一家咖啡馆。

sentence_examples.en: The speaker tried to get the idea across to the audience.
sentence_examples.zh: 演讲者设法把这个想法传达给听众。

translations.translation: 行动 表演 表现 充当 见效
表演 扮演
行为 行动 法案 （戏剧、歌剧等的）一幕

sentence_examples.en: If you notice a problem, you should act quickly.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你发现问题，应迅速采取行动。

sentence_examples.en: She will act as the lead in the new play.
sentence_examples.zh: 她将在新剧中担任主角。

sentence_examples.en: The new act requires employers to provide paid leave.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项新法案要求雇主提供带薪休假。

translations.translation: 起诉 行动 作用 功能 情节 活动

sentence_examples.en: We must take action to reduce pollution.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们必须采取行动来减少污染。

sentence_examples.en: She filed an action against her employer.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对雇主提起诉讼。

sentence_examples.en: The movie is full of action.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影充满动作场景。

translations.translation: 活跃的 积极的 主动的

sentence_examples.en: She stays physically active by jogging every morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 她每天早晨慢跑，保持身体活跃。

sentence_examples.en: The team remained active in the community by volunteering.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个团队通过志愿服务在社区保持活跃。

sentence_examples.en: He is an active participant in class.
sentence_examples.zh: 他是课堂上积极的参与者。

translations.translation: 活动 活跃 活力 行动
表演
厉害

sentence_examples.en: The school organized several activities this semester.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个学期学校组织了几项活动。

sentence_examples.en: Playing soccer is a popular after-school activity.
sentence_examples.zh: 足球是一项很受欢迎的课后活动。

sentence_examples.en: The activity will start at 9 AM and last two hours.
sentence_examples.zh: 活动将于上午9点开始，持续两小时。

translations.translation: 男演员 演剧的人

sentence_examples.en: An actor rehearses scenes daily to prepare for the show.
sentence_examples.zh: 一名演员每天排练场景，为演出做准备。

sentence_examples.en: The actor won an award for their performance.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位演员因其表演获得了一个奖项。

sentence_examples.en: She works as an actor in a local theater.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在当地剧院担任演员。

translations.translation: 女演员

sentence_examples.en: The famous actress arrived on the red carpet in a sparkling gown.
sentence_examples.zh: 那位著名的女演员穿着闪亮的晚礼服出现在红毯上。

sentence_examples.en: As a child, she dreamed of becoming an actress.
sentence_examples.zh: 小时候，她梦想成为一名女演员。

sentence_examples.en: The actress greeted her fans after the show.
sentence_examples.zh: 演出结束后，女演员向粉丝们打招呼。

translations.translation: 实际的 真实的 现行的

sentence_examples.en: The actual cost was higher than we expected.
sentence_examples.zh: 实际成本比我们预期的要高。

sentence_examples.en: She told me the actual date of the event.
sentence_examples.zh: 她告诉我活动的实际日期。

sentence_examples.en: We need the actual numbers, not estimates.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要实际的数字，而不是估算。

translations.translation: 实际上 事实上 居然 竟然（表示惊讶）

sentence_examples.en: I thought the movie would be boring, but it was actually fantastic.
sentence_examples.zh: 我以为这部电影会很无聊，结果其实很精彩。

sentence_examples.en: She isn't angry; she is actually surprised.
sentence_examples.zh: 她并不生气，实际上她很惊讶。

sentence_examples.en: Do you actually want to quit your job?
sentence_examples.zh: 你真的想辞职吗？

translations.translation: 尖的 锐的 敏锐的 敏锐的 激烈的

sentence_examples.en: The acute angle of the triangle is 45 degrees.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个三角形的锐角是45度。

sentence_examples.en: She has an acute sense of hearing.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的听力很敏锐。

sentence_examples.en: The patient has acute abdominal pain.
sentence_examples.zh: 患者有急性腹痛。

translations.translation: (缩)广告
bbr (
ertisement [əd'
ə:tismə
t] 的缩写 ) 广告

sentence_examples.en: I saw an ad for a new phone in the newspaper.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在报纸上看到了一则新手机的广告。

sentence_examples.en: The ad at the bus stop catches my eye.
sentence_examples.zh: 公交车站的广告吸引了我的注意。

sentence_examples.en: Companies spend a lot on TV ads.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司在电视广告上花费很多钱。

translations.translation: 使适应 改编
适应 适合

sentence_examples.en: Animals adapt to their environment over generations.
sentence_examples.zh: 动物通过几代逐渐适应环境。

sentence_examples.en: The story was adapted into a movie.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个故事被改编成了一部电影。

sentence_examples.en: If plans don't work, you can adapt them.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果计划行不通，你可以对它们进行调整。

translations.translation: 添加 附加 掺加 增加

sentence_examples.en: Please add more salt to the soup.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在汤里再加点盐。

sentence_examples.en: You should add this sentence to the report.
sentence_examples.zh: 你应该把这句话加入到报告中。

sentence_examples.en: We need to add a new feature to the app.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要在应用中添加一个新功能。

translations.translation: 加 加法 附加物 增加

sentence_examples.en: In mathematics, addition is the operation of combining two numbers to obtain a sum.
sentence_examples.zh: 在数学中，加法是把两个数相加得到和的运算。

sentence_examples.en: The new wing is a welcome addition to the museum.
sentence_examples.zh: 新展馆是博物馆的一个受欢迎的补充。

sentence_examples.en: The editor asked for an addition to the article.
sentence_examples.zh: 编辑要求对文章进行补充。

translations.translation: 附加的 追加的 另外的

sentence_examples.en: We need additional resources to complete this project.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要额外的资源来完成这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: There will be an additional charge for late delivery.
sentence_examples.zh: 延迟交付将产生额外费用。

sentence_examples.en: We added an additional chair to the conference room.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在会议室又放置了一把额外的椅子。

translations.translation: 地址 住址 致词 讲话 演说 谈吐 (处理问题的)技巧
发表演说 写地址 称呼 对付 ( 图书、文章等)讨论(某主题)

sentence_examples.en: Please write your full address on the form.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在表格上写明你的完整地址。

sentence_examples.en: The mayor delivered an address to the city about the new policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 市长就新政策向全城发表致辞。

sentence_examples.en: We need to address the issue of rising costs.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要解决成本上涨的问题。

translations.translation: 足够的 充足的 适当的 可以胜任的

sentence_examples.en: The budget is adequate to cover all the basic expenses.
sentence_examples.zh: 预算足以覆盖所有基本开支。

sentence_examples.en: Her qualifications are adequate for the position.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的资历足以胜任这个职位。

sentence_examples.en: We have adequate time to finish the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们有足够的时间完成这个项目。

translations.translation: 形容词
形容词的 不独立的

sentence_examples.en: An adjective is a word that describes a noun.
sentence_examples.zh: 形容词是用来描述名词的词。

sentence_examples.en: In English, 'blue' is an adjective.
sentence_examples.zh: 在英语中，'blue' 是一个形容词。

sentence_examples.en: Adjectives usually come before the nouns they describe.
sentence_examples.zh: 形容词通常放在它们所描述的名词前面。

translations.translation: 调整 调节 校正 使适于
适应

sentence_examples.en: Please adjust the thermostat to 22 degrees.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把恒温器调到22摄氏度。

sentence_examples.en: It took her a while to adjust to the new schedule.
sentence_examples.zh: 她花了一段时间才适应新日程。

sentence_examples.en: Adjust the mirror so you can see clearly.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把镜子调整到你能看清楚的角度。

translations.translation: 管理 行政 管理部门

sentence_examples.en: The administration released a new policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 行政部门发布了新政策。

sentence_examples.en: She works in the university administration.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在大学的行政部门工作。

sentence_examples.en: The administration is planning budget cuts.
sentence_examples.zh: 行政部门正在计划预算削减。

translations.translation: 钦佩 羡慕 赞赏

sentence_examples.en: I really admire your hard work.
sentence_examples.zh: 我真的钦佩你的努力。

sentence_examples.en: She admires her mother's kindness.
sentence_examples.zh: 她钦佩母亲的善良。

sentence_examples.en: We admire how you handled the situation.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们欣赏你处理这件事的方式。

translations.translation: 允许进入 承认 许可 入会费

sentence_examples.en: We paid for museum admission and entered.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们支付了博物馆的入场费后就进入参观。

sentence_examples.en: The suspect's admission of guilt surprised the jury.
sentence_examples.zh: 嫌疑人承认有罪，让陪审团感到吃惊。

sentence_examples.en: The admission price for the concert is $25.
sentence_examples.zh: 音乐会的入场费是25美元。

translations.translation: 承认 准许进入
允许进入 允许 承认

sentence_examples.en: The museum will admit visitors with a valid ticket.
sentence_examples.zh: 博物馆会允许持有效票的人进入。

sentence_examples.en: She admitted that she forgot to bring the invitation.
sentence_examples.zh: 她承认自己忘带了邀请函。

sentence_examples.en: They admitted him to the university after the interview.
sentence_examples.zh: 面试后，他们把他录取进了这所大学。

translations.translation: 收养 采用 采取 接受

sentence_examples.en: They decided to adopt a child from the foster care system.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们决定从福利机构领养一个孩子。

sentence_examples.en: The company decided to adopt a new sustainability policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司决定采用一项新的可持续发展政策。

sentence_examples.en: She adopted a healthier lifestyle after the diagnosis.
sentence_examples.zh: 诊断后她养成了更健康的生活方式。

translations.translation: 成年人
成年的 成人的 成熟的

sentence_examples.en: An adult must sign the consent form.
sentence_examples.zh: 成年人必须签署同意书。

sentence_examples.en: Children under 18 are not considered adults.
sentence_examples.zh: 18岁以下的儿童不被视为成年人。

sentence_examples.en: The event requires adult supervision.
sentence_examples.zh: 活动需要成年人监督。

translations.translation: 前进 进展 进步 预支
前进 增涨 预先
前进 提高 提升
预先的 提前的

sentence_examples.en: The army began to advance toward the ridge.
sentence_examples.zh: 部队开始向山脊前进。

sentence_examples.en: There has been an advance in technology recently.
sentence_examples.zh: 最近科技取得了进展。

sentence_examples.en: We asked for an advance on our salary.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们申请了工资预支。

translations.translation: 先进的 高级的

sentence_examples.en: She enrolled in an advanced math course.
sentence_examples.zh: 她报名参加了高级数学课程。

sentence_examples.en: The new smartphone has advanced features.
sentence_examples.zh: 这款新智能手机具有先进的功能。

sentence_examples.en: He is at an advanced stage of the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 他处于该项目的后期阶段。

translations.translation: 优点 优势 有利条件 好处
有利于

sentence_examples.en: She took advantage of the new technology.
sentence_examples.zh: 她利用了新技术的优势。

sentence_examples.en: Having a flexible schedule is to your advantage.
sentence_examples.zh: 灵活的日程安排对你有利。

sentence_examples.en: One advantage of this plan is its low cost.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个计划的一个优点是成本低。

translations.translation: 冒险 奇遇 惊险活动
冒险 尝试
大胆进行 冒险

sentence_examples.en: We set out on a grand adventure to explore the mountains.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们踏上了一场伟大的冒险去探索山脉。

sentence_examples.en: The explorers adventured into the jungle despite the danger.
sentence_examples.zh: 探险家们不顾危险，深入丛林探险。

sentence_examples.en: They decided to adventure into the unknown.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们决定冒险进入未知之地。

translations.translation: 副词
副词的

sentence_examples.en: An adverb describes how a verb is done.
sentence_examples.zh: 副词用于描述动词是如何完成的。

sentence_examples.en: In the sentence 'She sings beautifully,' beautifully is an adverb.
sentence_examples.zh: 在句子 'She sings beautifully' 中，beautifully 是副词。

sentence_examples.en: We usually place adverbs after the verb or at the end of the sentence.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们通常把副词放在动词之后，或放在句末。

translations.translation: 广告 公告 登广告

sentence_examples.en: I saw an advertisement for a new phone on the bus.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在公交车上看到了一则新款手机的广告。

sentence_examples.en: The advertisement on TV was catchy.
sentence_examples.zh: 电视上的广告很吸引人。

sentence_examples.en: They placed a large advertisement on the side of the building.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在大楼的侧面放了一则广告。

translations.translation: 劝告 忠告 意见 建议

sentence_examples.en: I asked for advice on what career to pursue.
sentence_examples.zh: 我请教了应该从事什么职业的建议。

sentence_examples.en: She gave me good advice about studying abroad.
sentence_examples.zh: 她给了我关于出国留学的很有用的建议。

sentence_examples.en: Taking advice from a trusted mentor can be very helpful.
sentence_examples.zh: 向值得信任的导师寻求忠告会非常有帮助。

translations.translation: 明智的 可取的

sentence_examples.en: It is advisable to arrive early to avoid delays.
sentence_examples.zh: 为了避免延误，最好提前到达。

sentence_examples.en: In this situation, it would be advisable to consult a lawyer.
sentence_examples.zh: 在这种情况下，咨询律师是明智的。

sentence_examples.en: If you plan to apply for the program, it may be advisable to strengthen your portfolio.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你计划申请该项目，完善你的作品集可能是明智的。

translations.translation: 劝告 建议 通知 警告
劝告 与商量

sentence_examples.en: The doctor advised me to rest for a few days.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生建议我休息几天。

sentence_examples.en: I would advise you to check the weather before leaving.
sentence_examples.zh: 我建议你在出门前查看天气。

sentence_examples.en: She advised him not to sign the contract before reading it.
sentence_examples.zh: 她建议他在阅读合同之前不要签署合同。

translations.translation: 飞机

sentence_examples.en: The aeroplane took off on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 这架飞机准时起飞。

sentence_examples.en: The aeroplane landed safely after a smooth flight.
sentence_examples.zh: 这架飞机在一次平稳的飞行后安全降落。

sentence_examples.en: The aeroplane was delayed due to bad weather.
sentence_examples.zh: 由于恶劣天气，这架飞机延误了。

translations.translation: 飞机的 航空的 飞行的

sentence_examples.en: The aero industry is growing quickly.
sentence_examples.zh: 航空行业正在迅速增长。

sentence_examples.en: He works for an aero engineering company.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在一家航空工程公司工作。

sentence_examples.en: The plane's aero design reduces drag.
sentence_examples.zh: 这架飞机的航空设计降低了阻力。

translations.translation: 事情 事件 事务 绯闻

sentence_examples.en: The wedding was a grand affair.
sentence_examples.zh: 婚礼是一场盛大的活动。

sentence_examples.en: He had an affair with the secretary.
sentence_examples.zh: 他和秘书有婚外情。

sentence_examples.en: I have some personal affairs to take care of.
sentence_examples.zh: 我有一些私事要处理。

translations.translation: 影响 感动 作用

sentence_examples.en: The weather can affect your mood.
sentence_examples.zh: 天气会影响你的情绪。

sentence_examples.en: The speaker's story affected the audience.
sentence_examples.zh: 演讲者的故事打动了观众。

sentence_examples.en: This policy will affect the way the company operates.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项政策将影响公司的运作方式。

translations.translation: 慈爱 爱 爱慕 影响 喜爱 感情

sentence_examples.en: She showed great affection for her grandmother.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对祖母表现出深厚的感情。

sentence_examples.en: The letter was written with affection and care.
sentence_examples.zh: 这封信写得充满深情和关怀。

sentence_examples.en: He felt affection for his dog.
sentence_examples.zh: 他对他的狗有感情。

translations.translation: 担负得起(后果 损失等) 提供 给予

sentence_examples.en: I can't afford a new car.
sentence_examples.zh: 我买不起新车。

sentence_examples.en: The grant will afford the researchers the resources they need.
sentence_examples.zh: 这笔资助将为研究人员提供他们所需的资源。

sentence_examples.en: There isn't enough money to afford a new server.
sentence_examples.zh: 没有足够的钱买一台新服务器。

translations.translation: 害怕的 担心的

sentence_examples.en: I'm afraid of spiders.
sentence_examples.zh: 我怕蜘蛛。

sentence_examples.en: She looked afraid when she heard the thunder.
sentence_examples.zh: 她听到雷声时看起来很害怕。

sentence_examples.en: Don't be afraid to ask for help.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要害怕寻求帮助。

translations.translation: 非洲

sentence_examples.en: Africa is the second-largest continent by land area.
sentence_examples.zh: 非洲是按陆地面积计算的第二大洲。

sentence_examples.en: Many diverse cultures are found across Africa.
sentence_examples.zh: 非洲各地有着丰富多样的文化。

sentence_examples.en: Africa has many languages and abundant wildlife.
sentence_examples.zh: 非洲有多种语言，也有丰富的野生动物。

translations.translation: 非洲的 非洲人的
非洲人

sentence_examples.en: She studied African history at university.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在大学学习非洲历史。

sentence_examples.en: An African artist will be performing at the gallery.
sentence_examples.zh: 一位非洲艺术家将在画廊表演。

sentence_examples.en: The African savanna is home to many animals.
sentence_examples.zh: 非洲草原是许多动物的家园。

translations.translation: 以后的
以后 后来
在以后
在以后 次于

sentence_examples.en: After the meeting, we went to lunch.
sentence_examples.zh: 会议结束后，我们去吃午饭。

sentence_examples.en: They moved to a new city after their wedding.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们婚后搬到了一个新城市。

sentence_examples.en: He arrived shortly after.
sentence_examples.zh: 他不久后到了。

translations.translation: 下午 午后
下午好

sentence_examples.en: I'll see you this afternoon at the library.
sentence_examples.zh: 我今天下午在图书馆见你。

sentence_examples.en: Good afternoon, everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 大家下午好。

sentence_examples.en: The afternoon breeze cooled the city.
sentence_examples.zh: 下午的微风让城市变得凉爽。

translations.translation: 后来 以后

sentence_examples.en: We had lunch, and afterward we visited the museum.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们吃完午饭后，随后参观了博物馆。

sentence_examples.en: The project will be reviewed, and afterward we will decide on the next steps.
sentence_examples.zh: 项目将被评审，之后我们将决定下一步。

sentence_examples.en: If you finish early, we can talk afterward.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你早点完成，我们之后再谈。

translations.translation: 又一次 而且 又 再 另一方面

sentence_examples.en: I forgot my keys again.
sentence_examples.zh: 我又把钥匙忘了。

sentence_examples.en: Can you explain that again?
sentence_examples.zh: 你能再解释一遍吗？

sentence_examples.en: Let's try again tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们明天再试一次。

translations.translation: 倚在 倚靠 逆 对着 反对 违背 防御 相比 相对

sentence_examples.en: She leaned against the wall.
sentence_examples.zh: 她靠在墙上。

sentence_examples.en: They spoke against the plan.

sentence_examples.en: Communism is a political and economic theory that aims to create a classless society.
sentence_examples.zh: 共产主义是一种政治和经济理论，旨在建立无阶级的社会。

sentence_examples.en: In a Communist economy, the means of production are owned collectively and production is planned by the state.
sentence_examples.zh: 在共产主义经济体制中，生产资料公有，生产由国家计划安排。

sentence_examples.en: Several countries in the 20th century described themselves as Communist and pursued different versions of the idea.
sentence_examples.zh: 在20世纪，几个国家自称为共产主义国家，并追求这一理念的不同版本。

translations.translation: 共产党员 共产主义者
共产主义的

sentence_examples.en: He was a communist who believed in equality and workers' rights.
sentence_examples.zh: 他是一名共产主义者，相信平等与工人权利。

sentence_examples.en: Students study communist theory in class.
sentence_examples.zh: 学生在课堂上学习共产主义理论。

sentence_examples.en: The communists organized a charity drive in the city.
sentence_examples.zh: 共产主义者在城市里组织了一场慈善募捐活动。

translations.translation: 社区 团体 社会 公社 群落(生)

sentence_examples.en: The local community organized a neighborhood clean-up day.
sentence_examples.zh: 当地社区组织了一场邻里清洁日。

sentence_examples.en: She volunteers at the community center every weekend.
sentence_examples.zh: 她每个周末都在社区中心做志愿者。

sentence_examples.en: A strong sense of community helps neighborhoods thrive.
sentence_examples.zh: 强烈的社区归属感有助于社区的发展。

translations.translation: 同伴 同事 共事者 伴侣 成对物品之一 (船的)甲板间扶梯(或扶梯的顶篷)
陪伴

sentence_examples.en: My best friend is my constant companion on long hikes.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的最好的朋友在长途徒步时是我不变的伙伴。

sentence_examples.en: She introduced him as her travel companion.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把他介绍为她的旅伴。

sentence_examples.en: A loyal dog is a wonderful companion.
sentence_examples.zh: 一只忠诚的狗是极好的伙伴。

translations.translation: 公司 商号 同伴 客人 一群 连队
陪伴
联合

sentence_examples.en: The company announced a new product line.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家公司宣布推出新产品线。

sentence_examples.en: I enjoyed the company of my colleagues at the conference.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在会议上很享受同事们的陪伴。

sentence_examples.en: A company of actors performed on stage.
sentence_examples.zh: 一团演员在舞台上表演。

translations.translation: 比较的 相对的
对手

sentence_examples.en: In a comparative study, researchers compare the effects of different treatments.
sentence_examples.zh: 在比较研究中，研究人员比较不同处理的效果。

sentence_examples.en: Her report uses a comparative approach to analyze the data.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的报告采用对比的方法来分析数据。

sentence_examples.en: The other team is the comparative in this match.
sentence_examples.zh: 在这场比赛中，对方队是我们的对手。

translations.translation: 比较 对照 比作 比喻
比较 对照

sentence_examples.en: When you compare the two models, Model A is lighter and has longer battery life.
sentence_examples.zh: 在比较这两款型号时，型号A更轻，电池续航更长。

sentence_examples.en: Don't compare yourself to others; focus on your own progress.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要把自己和别人相比；专注于自己的进步。

sentence_examples.en: The author compares the city to a maze to show how confusing it can be.
sentence_examples.zh: 作者把这座城市比作迷宫，以显示它有多么让人困惑。

translations.translation: 比较 对照 比似

sentence_examples.en: In comparison with last year, sales have increased.
sentence_examples.zh: 与去年相比，销售额有所增长。

sentence_examples.en: The report makes a fair comparison between the two methods.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告对这两种方法进行了公平的比较。

sentence_examples.en: Before deciding, do a quick comparison of prices.
sentence_examples.zh: 在决定前，先对价格进行一次快速比较。

translations.translation: 罗盘 指南针 圆规
图谋 包围 达成

sentence_examples.en: He checked the compass to find north.
sentence_examples.zh: 他查看指南针以确定北方。

sentence_examples.en: She used a compass to draw a circle on the map.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用圆规在地图上画圆。

sentence_examples.en: The army sought to compass the town with a ring of troops.
sentence_examples.zh: 军队试图以一圈部队包围这座城镇。

translations.translation: 强迫 迫使屈服

sentence_examples.en: The manager compelled the team to finish the project by Friday.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理强迫团队在周五前完成项目。

sentence_examples.en: Harsh conditions compelled him to abandon the mission.
sentence_examples.zh: 严苛的条件迫使他放弃任务。

sentence_examples.en: Many people feel compelled to help those in need.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多人感到有义务去帮助需要帮助的人。

translations.translation: 比赛 竞争 对抗

sentence_examples.en: Companies compete for customers in a crowded market.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司在竞争激烈的市场中争夺客户。

sentence_examples.en: Athletes will compete in the regional championship next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 运动员们将于下个月在区域锦标赛中比赛。

sentence_examples.en: The two teams compete for the top prize.
sentence_examples.zh: 两支队伍为赢得最高奖项而竞争。

translations.translation: 有能力的 胜任的 足够的 应该做的

sentence_examples.en: She is a competent manager who can handle crises.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是一位有能力的经理，能应对危机。

sentence_examples.en: The team is competent and can complete the project on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个团队很有能力，能够按时完成项目。

sentence_examples.en: He proved he was competent by finishing the project ahead of schedule.
sentence_examples.zh: 他通过提前完成项目来证明自己胜任。

translations.translation: 竞争 比赛

sentence_examples.en: There is a lot of competition in the smartphone market.
sentence_examples.zh: 智能手机市场竞争激烈。

sentence_examples.en: She trained hard to win the regional science competition.
sentence_examples.zh: 她努力训练，参加区域科学竞赛以争取胜利。

sentence_examples.en: The competition among local gyms is growing.
sentence_examples.zh: 本地健身房之间的竞争在加剧。

translations.translation: 编辑 编制 编译 编纂 搜集

sentence_examples.en: She will compile a report from the data she collected.
sentence_examples.zh: 她将把所收集的数据编成一份报告。

sentence_examples.en: The librarian compiled a bibliography of all sources used in the study.
sentence_examples.zh: 图书馆员编制了研究中使用的所有来源的书目。

sentence_examples.en: We need to compile a budget for the next quarter.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要编制下一个季度的预算。

translations.translation: 抱怨 拆苦 悲叹 控告 控诉

sentence_examples.en: I don't want to complain, but this soup is cold.
sentence_examples.zh: 我不想抱怨，但这汤是冷的。

sentence_examples.en: She often complains about the weather.
sentence_examples.zh: 她常常抱怨天气。

sentence_examples.en: Customers can complain to the staff if there is a problem.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果有问题，顾客可以向工作人员投诉。

translations.translation: 抱怨 怨言 控告

sentence_examples.en: She filed a complaint with customer service about the broken toaster.
sentence_examples.zh: 她就坏掉的烤面包机向客服提出了投诉。

sentence_examples.en: The manager listened to the complaint and offered a refund.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理听取了顾客的投诉并提供了退款。

sentence_examples.en: Her complaint was that the restaurant was too noisy.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的抱怨是餐厅太吵。

translations.translation: 完整的 完成的 彻底的
完成 使圆满 使完美

sentence_examples.en: The project is not complete yet.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目还没有完成。

sentence_examples.en: Please complete the form before submitting.
sentence_examples.zh: 提交前请把表格填写完整。

sentence_examples.en: She gave a complete answer.
sentence_examples.zh: 她给出了完整的答案。

translations.translation: 十分 完全地 全然

sentence_examples.en: The plan was completely different from what we expected.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个计划与我们预期的完全不同。

sentence_examples.en: She completely understood the instructions after rereading them.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在重新阅读后完全理解了这些指示。

sentence_examples.en: I completely forgot about the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 我完全忘记了那场会议。

translations.translation: 结合的 复杂的
复合体

sentence_examples.en: The instructions are too complex to follow.
sentence_examples.zh: 说明书太复杂，难以按照步骤执行。

sentence_examples.en: The apartment complex is on the west side of the mall.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座公寓综合体位于商场西侧。

sentence_examples.en: The city has a complex network of roads that connects the center to the suburbs.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座城市有一条错综复杂的道路网络，把市中心与郊区连接起来。

translations.translation: 使复杂 使陷入 使错综 使起纠纷

sentence_examples.en: Poor planning will only complicate the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 糟糕的规划只会让项目变得更复杂。

sentence_examples.en: Adding more exceptions to the rule could complicate things.
sentence_examples.zh: 在规则中再增加例外可能会让事情变得更复杂。

sentence_examples.en: The new policy could complicate their negotiations.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策可能会让他们的谈判变得更加复杂。

translations.translation: 复杂的 难懂的

sentence_examples.en: The instructions for assembling the furniture are complicated.
sentence_examples.zh: 组装家具的说明很复杂。

sentence_examples.en: The math problem looked complicated at first.
sentence_examples.zh: 起初那道数学题看起来很复杂。

sentence_examples.en: The plot of the novel is complicated, with many twists.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部小说的情节很复杂，充满了转折。

translations.translation: 组成部分 分 组件 元件 成份
组成的 构成的

sentence_examples.en: The motherboard is a key component of the computer.
sentence_examples.zh: 主板是电脑的一个关键组成部分。

sentence_examples.en: Each component must pass quality tests before shipment.
sentence_examples.zh: 每个组件在出货前都必须通过质量检验。

sentence_examples.en: These components combine to form a complete device.
sentence_examples.zh: 这些组件组合在一起，形成一台完整的设备。

translations.translation: 组成 构成 创作 写作 作曲 使镇静
创作

sentence_examples.en: She will compose a new symphony for the orchestra.
sentence_examples.zh: 她将为管弦乐团创作一部新的交响曲。

sentence_examples.en: The committee is composed of five members.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会由五名成员组成。

sentence_examples.en: He tried to compose himself after hearing the bad news.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在听到坏消息后努力镇定自己。

translations.translation: 构成 作品 写作 作文 著作 组织 合成物 成份

sentence_examples.en: Her composition for English class was praised by the teacher.
sentence_examples.zh: 她为英语课写的作文受到了老师的表扬。

sentence_examples.en: The concert featured a new musical composition by a young composer.
sentence_examples.zh: 音乐会以一位年轻作曲家的新作作为曲目。

sentence_examples.en: The chemical composition of water is hydrogen and oxygen.
sentence_examples.zh: 水的化学组成是氢和氧。

translations.translation: 化合物 混合物 复合词
复(混)合的 合成的
混合 调合 妥协
混合 妥协

sentence_examples.en: Water is a compound made of hydrogen and oxygen.
sentence_examples.zh: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。

sentence_examples.en: The word 'sunflower' is a compound word.
sentence_examples.zh: 单词 'sunflower' 是一个复合词。

sentence_examples.en: The pharmacist can compound a medication to fit the patient's needs.
sentence_examples.zh: 药师可以按患者需要配制药物。

translations.translation: 理解 理解力 领悟

sentence_examples.en: Her comprehension of the topic improved after reading the article.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在读完这篇文章后，对这个主题的理解提高了。

sentence_examples.en: The exam assesses reading comprehension.
sentence_examples.zh: 考试评估阅读理解能力。

sentence_examples.en: Practice helps your comprehension grow over time.
sentence_examples.zh: 练习可以让你的理解力随时间提升。

translations.translation: 广泛的 理解的 综合的

sentence_examples.en: The report provides a comprehensive overview of the market.
sentence_examples.zh: 该报告对市场进行了全面的概述。

sentence_examples.en: She wrote a comprehensive guide to photography for beginners.
sentence_examples.zh: 她为初学者撰写了一本全面的摄影指南。

sentence_examples.en: The school offers a comprehensive program that covers math, science, and the arts.
sentence_examples.zh: 学校提供一个涵盖数学、科学和艺术的综合课程。

translations.translation: 压紧 压缩 [计算机] 压缩

sentence_examples.en: You can compress the files to save disk space.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以把文件压缩以节省磁盘空间。

sentence_examples.en: The software can compress images to reduce their file size.
sentence_examples.zh: 该软件可以压缩图像以减小文件大小。

sentence_examples.en: Before sending the folder, compress it into a ZIP file.
sentence_examples.zh: 在发送文件夹之前，将其压缩成一个 ZIP 文件。

translations.translation: 包含 包括 构成

sentence_examples.en: The menu comprises three main courses and several side dishes.
sentence_examples.zh: 菜单包含三道主菜和若干配菜。

sentence_examples.en: The committee comprises ten members.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会由十名成员组成。

sentence_examples.en: A good report comprises clear data and well-supported conclusions.
sentence_examples.zh: 一份好的报告包括清晰的数据和充分的结论。

translations.translation: 妥协 让步 和解 折衷 折衷案
妥协处理 危害
妥协 让步

sentence_examples.en: The two sides reached a compromise.
sentence_examples.zh: 双方达成妥协。

sentence_examples.en: We should not compromise safety for speed.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们不应为了速度而牺牲安全。

sentence_examples.en: In negotiations, it's hard to avoid compromising.
sentence_examples.zh: 在谈判中，很难避免妥协。

translations.translation: 计算 估计 估算

sentence_examples.en: The calculator can compute the total cost, including tax.
sentence_examples.zh: 计算器可以算出总成本（含税）。

sentence_examples.en: Researchers compute the probability of failure using simulations.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员使用仿真来计算失败的概率。

sentence_examples.en: You can compute the average score by adding all values and dividing by the number of items.
sentence_examples.zh: 把所有数值相加再除以数量就能得到平均分。

translations.translation: 计算机 电脑

sentence_examples.en: I bought a new computer yesterday.
sentence_examples.zh: 我昨天买了一台新电脑。

sentence_examples.en: The computer is on the desk.
sentence_examples.zh: 这台电脑在桌子上。

sentence_examples.en: He uses his computer for work.
sentence_examples.zh: 他用电脑工作。

translations.translation: 同志 亲密的同伴

sentence_examples.en: In the parade, soldiers saluted their comrade in arms.
sentence_examples.zh: 在游行中，士兵们向并肩作战的战友致敬。

sentence_examples.en: She called him comrade to show solidarity with the movement.
sentence_examples.zh: 她称他为同志，以表示对这场运动的团结。

sentence_examples.en: My old comrade and I started this project together.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的老同伴和我一起开始了这个项目。

translations.translation: 把隐藏起来 掩盖

sentence_examples.en: He tried to conceal his disappointment after failing the exam.
sentence_examples.zh: 他试图掩饰自己考试失败后的失望。

sentence_examples.en: She wore sunglasses to conceal her eyes from the paparazzi.
sentence_examples.zh: 她戴着太阳镜来遮掩眼睛，避免被狗仔拍到。

sentence_examples.en: The fog concealed the harbor from view.
sentence_examples.zh: 雾把港口遮挡在视线之外。

translations.translation: 集中 专心 聚集 浓缩
浓缩 精选

sentence_examples.en: Please concentrate on your work.
sentence_examples.zh: 请专心工作。

sentence_examples.en: She tried to concentrate her attention on the speaker.
sentence_examples.zh: 她努力把注意力集中在发言人身上。

sentence_examples.en: I bought orange juice concentrate to make a smoothie.
sentence_examples.zh: 我买了橙汁浓缩物来做奶昔。

translations.translation: 集中 专心 专注 浓缩 浓度

sentence_examples.en: Her concentration stayed high during the exam.
sentence_examples.zh: 考试期间她的专注力一直很高。

sentence_examples.en: A loud noise interrupted his concentration.
sentence_examples.zh: 嘈杂的声音打断了他的注意力。

sentence_examples.en: The scientist measured the concentration of salt in the solution.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家测量了溶液中的盐的浓度。

translations.translation: 概念 观念 设想

sentence_examples.en: The concept of time is different in various cultures.
sentence_examples.zh: 在不同文化中，时间的概念不同。

sentence_examples.en: She struggled to grasp the concept behind the theory.
sentence_examples.zh: 她难以理解这个理论背后的概念。

sentence_examples.en: They discussed the concept of sustainability in the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在项目中讨论了可持续性的概念。

translations.translation: 关心(人或事) 忧虑 挂念 关系 公司 企业
涉及 影响 关心

sentence_examples.en: Her main concern is the safety of the children.
sentence_examples.zh: 她最担心的是孩子们的安全。

sentence_examples.en: The new policy raises concerns among residents.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项新政策在居民中引发担忧。

sentence_examples.en: This issue concerns the whole company.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个问题关系到整家公司。

translations.translation: 关于

sentence_examples.en: There are concerns concerning the device's safety.
sentence_examples.zh: 关于该设备的安全性有一些担忧。

sentence_examples.en: I received a memo concerning the upcoming audit.
sentence_examples.zh: 我收到了一份关于即将进行的审计的备忘录。

sentence_examples.en: Please email me any questions concerning the proposal.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把您对该提案的任何问题发给我。

translations.translation: 音乐会 演奏会 一致 和谐
制定计划 通过协商达成一致
合作

sentence_examples.en: We went to a concert last night.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们昨晚去参加了一场音乐会。

sentence_examples.en: The two teams worked in concert to finish the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两个团队携手合作完成了该项目。

sentence_examples.en: They reached a concerted plan after weeks of negotiation.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过数周的谈判，他们达成了一项经协商一致的计划。

translations.translation: 推断出 使结束 缔结 断定 得出结论
结束 作出决定

sentence_examples.en: From the data, we can conclude that the new policy is effective.
sentence_examples.zh: 根据数据，我们可以得出新政策是有效的。

sentence_examples.en: The conference concluded with a closing ceremony.
sentence_examples.zh: 会议以闭幕式结束。

sentence_examples.en: They concluded the contract after negotiations.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过谈判，他们缔结了合同。

translations.translation: 结论 推论 结尾

sentence_examples.en: In conclusion, the experiment supported the hypothesis.
sentence_examples.zh: 总之，这个实验支持了假设。

sentence_examples.en: The conclusion of the report is that sales increased significantly.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告的结论是销售额显著增加。

sentence_examples.en: We reached the conclusion that more data is needed.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们得出结论，需要更多数据。

translations.translation: 水泥 混凝土 具体物
具体的 实在的 水泥的
凝结 结合

sentence_examples.en: The workers mixed cement, sand, and water to make concrete for the sidewalk.
sentence_examples.zh: 工人把水泥、沙子和水混合，制成混凝土来修建人行道。

sentence_examples.en: The report provided concrete evidence of the problem.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告提供了这个问题的确凿证据。

sentence_examples.en: They will concrete the driveway next week.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们下周将把车道浇筑成混凝土。

translations.translation: 谴责 指责 判刑 官方宣称(某事物)有缺陷或不宜使用

sentence_examples.en: The committee condemned the policy as unfair and harmful.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会谴责该政策不公平且有害。

sentence_examples.en: The court condemned him to ten years in prison.
sentence_examples.zh: 法院判处他十年监禁。

sentence_examples.en: The building was condemned for safety reasons.
sentence_examples.zh: 该建筑因安全原因被宣布不宜使用。

translations.translation: 压缩 使缩短 浓缩 摘要

sentence_examples.en: We need to condense this report into a brief summary.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要把这份报告浓缩成一个简短的摘要。

sentence_examples.en: The scientist condensed the data into a single chart.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家把数据浓缩成一张图表。

sentence_examples.en: The steam condenses into water when it cools.
sentence_examples.zh: 蒸汽冷却时会凝结成水。

translations.translation: 状况 状态 环境 条件
以为条件 决定 支配 训练

sentence_examples.en: The patient is in good condition after surgery.
sentence_examples.zh: 手术后，患者状况良好。

sentence_examples.en: Access to the facility is granted only under certain conditions.
sentence_examples.zh: 进入该设施只有在某些条件下才被允许。

sentence_examples.zh: 亲人的去世让人很难承受。

sentence_examples.en: Many people fear death and what comes after.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多人害怕死亡以及死后会怎样。

sentence_examples.en: Vaccines can reduce the risk of death from certain diseases.
sentence_examples.zh: 疫苗可以降低某些疾病导致的死亡风险。

translations.translation: 争论 辩论 商讨
争论 思考

sentence_examples.en: The debate over climate policy lasted for hours.
sentence_examples.zh: 关于气候政策的辩论持续了数小时。

sentence_examples.en: They debated whether to expand the program.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们就是否扩大该计划进行了辩论。

sentence_examples.en: Students debated the pros and cons of the proposal.
sentence_examples.zh: 学生们辩论了提案的利弊。

translations.translation: 债 债务 欠债 负债状态 义务 罪 过失

sentence_examples.en: He ran up a debt after buying a new car.
sentence_examples.zh: 他买了新车后就背上了一笔债务。

sentence_examples.en: The company has accumulated a large debt.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司积累了大量债务。

sentence_examples.en: She owes a debt of gratitude to her teacher.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对老师心存感激之情。

translations.translation: 十年 十年期

sentence_examples.en: Over the past decade, technology has advanced rapidly.
sentence_examples.zh: 在过去的十年里，技术迅速进步。

sentence_examples.en: The project will take a decade to complete.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目需要十年时间才能完成。

sentence_examples.en: A decade of experience is often required for this job.
sentence_examples.zh: 这份工作通常需要十年的工作经验。

translations.translation: 腐烂 衰败
腐烂 衰退

sentence_examples.en: Fruit left in the sun will decay quickly.
sentence_examples.zh: 放在阳光下的水果会很快腐烂。

sentence_examples.en: Old wooden beams show decay after years of moisture.
sentence_examples.zh: 多年潮湿后，旧木梁出现腐朽。

sentence_examples.en: Regular maintenance slows the decay of wood.
sentence_examples.zh: 定期维护可以减缓木材的腐朽。

translations.translation: 欺骗 欺诈 诡计 不诚实

sentence_examples.en: The court found deceit in the company's advertising practices.
sentence_examples.zh: 法院认定该公司的广告宣传存在欺骗行为。

sentence_examples.en: Her deceit damaged her friend's trust.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的欺骗伤害了朋友的信任。

sentence_examples.en: Politicians often use deceit to win votes.
sentence_examples.zh: 政客常通过欺骗来赢得选票。

translations.translation: 欺骗 蒙蔽 行骗
行骗

sentence_examples.en: Don't deceive yourself into thinking you can finish the project in one night.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要自我欺骗，认为你一夜就能完成这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: They deceived the customers with false advertising.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们用虚假宣传欺骗了客户。

sentence_examples.en: She deceived me by presenting fake documents.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用伪造的文件来欺骗我。

translations.translation: 十二月

sentence_examples.en: December is the last month of the year.
sentence_examples.zh: 十二月是一年中的最后一个月。

sentence_examples.en: Many people celebrate Christmas in December.
sentence_examples.zh: 很多人在十二月庆祝圣诞节。

sentence_examples.en: We usually plan a vacation in December.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们通常在十二月计划一次假期。

translations.translation: 正派的 体面的 有分寸的 得体的 相当好的

sentence_examples.en: She is a decent person who always helps others.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是一个正派的人，总是帮助别人。

sentence_examples.en: That restaurant serves decent food at a reasonable price.
sentence_examples.zh: 那家餐馆的饭菜还算不错，价格也很合理。

sentence_examples.en: Please dress in decent clothes for the interview.
sentence_examples.zh: 请穿得体的衣服参加面试。

translations.translation: 决定 决心 解决 作出抉择

sentence_examples.en: We need to decide what to cook for dinner.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要决定晚饭吃什么。

sentence_examples.en: After weighing the options, she decided to move to a new city.
sentence_examples.zh: 在权衡各种选择后，她决定搬到一个新城市。

sentence_examples.en: The jury will decide the winner tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 陪审团明天将决定获胜者。

translations.translation: 决定 决心 果断 决策

sentence_examples.en: Making a quick decision can be risky.
sentence_examples.zh: 做出迅速的决定可能有风险。

sentence_examples.en: This decision will affect the whole team.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个决定将影响整个团队。

sentence_examples.en: He stuck to his decision despite objections.
sentence_examples.zh: 尽管有反对意见，他坚持自己的决定。

translations.translation: 甲板 舱面 层面 桥面 楼层
装饰

sentence_examples.en: The ship's deck was crowded with tourists.
sentence_examples.zh: 船甲板上挤满了游客。

sentence_examples.en: We sat on the deck and watched the sunset.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们坐在甲板上看日落。

sentence_examples.en: The halls were decked with garlands for the festival.
sentence_examples.zh: 大厅挂满花环迎接节日。

translations.translation: 断言 声明 表明 宣布 申报

sentence_examples.en: The president declared a state of emergency.
sentence_examples.zh: 总统宣布进入紧急状态。

sentence_examples.en: She declared her candidacy for mayor.
sentence_examples.zh: 她宣布自己竞选市长。

sentence_examples.en: When crossing the border, you must declare any goods.
sentence_examples.zh: 过境时，必须申报任何物品。

translations.translation: 装饰 装璜 修饰 授予某人奖章或其他奖状

sentence_examples.en: The living room is decorated with new wallpaper.
sentence_examples.zh: 客厅用新墙纸装饰。

sentence_examples.en: She decorated the cake with chocolate shavings.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用巧克力屑装饰了蛋糕。

sentence_examples.en: He was decorated with a medal for his bravery.
sentence_examples.zh: 他因勇敢而被授予奖章。

translations.translation: 减少 减少

sentence_examples.en: The number of new users decreased after the launch.
sentence_examples.zh: 推出后新用户数量下降。

sentence_examples.en: There was a decrease in demand for the product last quarter.
sentence_examples.zh: 上个季度对该产品的需求有所下降。

sentence_examples.en: You should decrease your speed when driving on wet roads.
sentence_examples.zh: 在湿滑路面上驾车时应降低车速。

translations.translation: 演绎 推论 推断 溯源

sentence_examples.en: From the footprints, we can deduce which animal passed by.
sentence_examples.zh: 从脚印可以推断出是哪种动物经过这里。

sentence_examples.en: Scientists deduce the origin of the meteorite by studying its isotopes.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家通过研究它的同位素来推断这块陨石的起源。

sentence_examples.en: The detective deduced the thief's plan from the scattered clues.
sentence_examples.zh: 侦探从散落的线索推断出窃贼的计划。

translations.translation: 行为 事迹 功绩 (尤指房产)契约 证书
通过行为转化

sentence_examples.en: Helping the elderly neighbor was a kind deed.
sentence_examples.zh: 帮助年迈的邻居是一件善举。

sentence_examples.en: The buyer signed the deed to transfer ownership of the house.
sentence_examples.zh: 买方签署了将房屋所有权转让的契据。

sentence_examples.en: The owner deeded the land to his daughter.
sentence_examples.zh: 房主把土地转让给了他的女儿。

translations.translation: 深的 有深的 深奥的 纵深的
深深地 晚地
深处

sentence_examples.en: The lake is deep.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个湖很深。

sentence_examples.en: She looked deep into his eyes.
sentence_examples.zh: 她深深地看进了他的眼睛。

sentence_examples.en: We explored the deep and found strange creatures.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们探索了深处，发现了奇怪的生物。

translations.translation: 加深 使加深 使强烈
深化 加深 变浓

sentence_examples.en: The conversation helped deepen our understanding of the issue.
sentence_examples.zh: 这次谈话加深了我们对这个问题的理解。

sentence_examples.en: The color deepens as the sun sets.
sentence_examples.zh: 太阳落山时，颜色会变深。

sentence_examples.en: The argument deepened the rift between them.
sentence_examples.zh: 这场争论加深了他们之间的裂痕。

translations.translation: 鹿

sentence_examples.en: I saw a deer in the park this morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天早上我在公园看见了一只鹿。

sentence_examples.en: That deer ran quickly across the field.
sentence_examples.zh: 那只鹿从田野里跑过去。

sentence_examples.en: Deer are usually shy.
sentence_examples.zh: 鹿通常很害羞。

translations.translation: 战胜 击败 挫败
败北 失败

sentence_examples.en: The coach wants to defeat the rivals in the final.
sentence_examples.zh: 教练想在决赛中击败对手。

sentence_examples.en: The defeat was hard for the players to accept.
sentence_examples.zh: 这场败北让球员很难接受。

sentence_examples.en: They defeated their opponents after a tough game.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在艰难的比赛后击败了对手。

translations.translation: 缺点 缺陷 欠缺
背叛

sentence_examples.en: The product has a defect that needs to be fixed.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个产品有一个缺陷需要修复。

sentence_examples.en: A manufacturing defect can cause the device to malfunction.
sentence_examples.zh: 制造缺陷可能导致设备发生故障。

sentence_examples.en: During the crisis, he defected to a neighboring country.
sentence_examples.zh: 在危机中，他叛逃到邻国。

translations.translation: 防御 防务 辩护 答辩

sentence_examples.en: The army built a strong defence along the coast.
sentence_examples.zh: 军队沿着海岸修筑了坚固的防御。

sentence_examples.en: She gave a solid defence of her thesis during the viva.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在论文答辩中对自己的论文作出了有力的辩护。

sentence_examples.en: The team's defence held off the opponents' attack.
sentence_examples.zh: 球队的防线抵挡住了对手的进攻。

translations.translation: 防护 辩护 防卫 保卫 防守

sentence_examples.en: Knights defend the castle against invaders.
sentence_examples.zh: 骑士们防守城堡，抵御入侵者。

sentence_examples.en: She defended her thesis with solid evidence.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用确凿的证据为她的论文辩护。

sentence_examples.en: Soldiers defended the road against the enemy's advance.
sentence_examples.zh: 士兵们防守这条道路，抵御敌军的推进。

translations.translation: 给下定义 限定 解释

sentence_examples.en: The teacher asked the students to define the term before continuing.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师要求学生在继续前给出这个术语的定义。

sentence_examples.en: We need to define the scope of the project to prevent scope creep.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要限定项目的范围，以防止范围蔓延。

sentence_examples.en: The contract defines each party's obligations clearly.
sentence_examples.zh: 合同明确规定了各方的义务。

translations.translation: 明确的 肯定的 一定的

sentence_examples.en: We have a definite plan for the weekend.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们对周末有明确的计划。

sentence_examples.en: There is definite proof that the suspect is guilty.
sentence_examples.zh: 有确凿的证据表明嫌疑人有罪。

sentence_examples.en: She gave a definite answer: yes.
sentence_examples.zh: 她给出了明确的回答：是的。

translations.translation: 一定地 明确地 确切地

sentence_examples.en: I definitely need a vacation after this project.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目结束后，我一定需要休假。

sentence_examples.en: She definitely spoke up during the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在会议上确实提出了自己的意见。

sentence_examples.en: If we follow the plan, this will definitely work.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果我们按这个计划执行，肯定会起作用。

translations.translation: 定义 释义 定界 阐释 清晰度

sentence_examples.en: Can you give me a clear definition of this word?
sentence_examples.zh: 你能给出这个单词的清晰定义吗？

sentence_examples.en: The definition of a term may depend on the field.
sentence_examples.zh: 术语的定义可能取决于领域。

sentence_examples.en: We need a precise definition before we proceed.
sentence_examples.zh: 在我们继续之前，我们需要一个精确的定义。

translations.translation: 程度 度 度数 学位

sentence_examples.en: He earned a master's degree in computer science.
sentence_examples.zh: 他获得了计算机科学的硕士学位。

sentence_examples.en: The water reached 100 degrees Celsius.
sentence_examples.zh: 水温达到了摄氏100度。

sentence_examples.en: The policy will improve outcomes to a large degree.
sentence_examples.zh: 政策在很大程度上会改善结果。

translations.translation: 推迟 耽搁 延误
耽搁
耽搁 迟滞

sentence_examples.en: The flight was delayed due to bad weather.
sentence_examples.zh: 由于恶劣天气，航班被延误了。

sentence_examples.en: There was a delay in the delivery of the package.
sentence_examples.zh: 包裹的交付出现了延迟。

sentence_examples.en: We should not delay making a decision.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们不应该拖延作出决定。

translations.translation: 删除 擦掉

sentence_examples.en: Please delete the duplicate file from the folder.
sentence_examples.zh: 请从该文件夹中删除重复的文件。

sentence_examples.en: You can delete old emails to free up storage.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以删除旧邮件来释放存储空间。

sentence_examples.en: The editor lets you delete a paragraph with one click.
sentence_examples.zh: 编辑器让你一键删除一个段落。

translations.translation: 代表团 委派

sentence_examples.en: The delegation from Spain will visit next week.
sentence_examples.zh: 来自西班牙的代表团将于下周访问。

sentence_examples.en: The president appointed a delegation to negotiate the treaty.
sentence_examples.zh: 总统任命了一个代表团去谈判条约。

sentence_examples.en: A delegation of workers was sent to city hall to demand better conditions.
sentence_examples.zh: 一支工人代表团被派往市政厅要求改善工作条件。

translations.translation: 纤细的 易碎的 精美的 微妙的 美味的 脆弱的 敏锐的
精美的东西

sentence_examples.en: The lace on her dress is delicate and can tear easily.
sentence_examples.zh: 她裙子上的花边很精致，容易破裂。

sentence_examples.en: This wine has a delicate flavor.
sentence_examples.zh: 这款酒有细腻的风味。

sentence_examples.en: The issue is delicate and requires careful handling.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个问题很微妙，需要小心处理。

translations.translation: 美味的 可口的 怡人的

sentence_examples.en: The soup tastes delicious.
sentence_examples.zh: 这汤尝起来很美味。

sentence_examples.en: That pie is delicious.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个馅饼很美味。

sentence_examples.en: She cooked a delicious meal.
sentence_examples.zh: 她做了一顿美味的饭。

translations.translation: 快乐 快乐
使高兴
给与乐趣

sentence_examples.en: Her face lit up with delight when she opened the letter.
sentence_examples.zh: 她打开信时，脸上露出欣喜的表情。

sentence_examples.en: The news delighted everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个消息让大家都很开心。

sentence_examples.en: He delights in solving puzzles.
sentence_examples.zh: 他乐于解谜。

translations.translation: 投递 递送 送交 发表 表达 释放 交付 接生 履行
达成

sentence_examples.en: The mail carrier will deliver your package tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 邮递员明天会把你的包裹送到你家。

sentence_examples.en: She delivered a powerful speech at the conference.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在大会上发表了一场有力的演讲。

sentence_examples.en: He delivered on his promise to finish the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 他兑现了承诺，完成了这个项目。

translations.translation: 投递 交付 分娩

sentence_examples.en: I scheduled the delivery for tomorrow morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 我把投递安排在明天早上。

sentence_examples.en: The delivery of the new laptops will require a signature.
sentence_examples.zh: 新笔记本的交付需要签名。

sentence_examples.en: Her delivery went smoothly.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的分娩过程很顺利。

translations.translation: 要求 需要 询问
要求 需求

sentence_examples.en: The company demands a higher level of service from its staff.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司要求员工提供更高水平的服务。

sentence_examples.en: There is a growing demand for affordable housing.
sentence_examples.zh: 对负担得起的住房的需求正在增长。

sentence_examples.en: Customers demanded a full refund after the faulty product.
sentence_examples.zh: 产品有缺陷后，顾客要求全额退款。

translations.translation: 民主 民主制 民主国家

sentence_examples.en: Democracy is a system of government in which the people have the power.
sentence_examples.zh: 民主是一种由人民掌握权力的政体。

sentence_examples.en: Many countries classify themselves as democracies.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多国家自称是民主国家。

sentence_examples.en: Elections are an essential part of a democracy.
sentence_examples.zh: 选举是民主制度的基本组成部分。

translations.translation: 民主的 民主政体的 大众的 平等的

sentence_examples.en: The country is a democratic nation with free elections.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个国家是一个拥有自由选举的民主国家。

sentence_examples.en: A democratic government listens to citizens through regular elections.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个民主政府通过定期选举听取公民意见。

sentence_examples.en: They promoted democratic reforms to expand voting rights.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们推动民主改革，扩大了投票权。

translations.translation: 说明 论证 证明 表露 示范 演示
示威

sentence_examples.en: The scientist will demonstrate how the new vaccine works.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家将演示新疫苗的工作原理。

sentence_examples.en: The data demonstrate a clear link between exercise and health.
sentence_examples.zh: 数据证明运动与健康之间存在明显联系。

sentence_examples.en: People gathered in the square to demonstrate against the new policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 人们聚集在广场示威，反对新政策。

translations.translation: 密集的 浓厚的 愚钝的 不易看透的

sentence_examples.en: The forest was so dense that I couldn't see more than a few feet ahead.
sentence_examples.zh: 森林太密集了，我前方只能看到几英尺远的地方。

sentence_examples.en: A dense fog lay over the valley, making the road hard to follow.
sentence_examples.zh: 山谷上方弥漫着浓雾，路面很难辨认。

sentence_examples.en: He can be dense at times and doesn’t understand obvious jokes.
sentence_examples.zh: 他有时很愚钝，听不懂明显的笑话。

translations.translation: 密集 稠密 密度 透明度

sentence_examples.en: The population density of the city is very high.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个城市的人口密度非常高。

sentence_examples.en: Water has a density of 1 gram per cubic centimeter at 4°C.
sentence_examples.zh: 水在4°C时的密度为每立方厘米1克。

sentence_examples.en: The density of the fog reduced visibility.
sentence_examples.zh: 浓雾的密度降低了能见度。

translations.translation: 否定 拒绝相信 拒绝 反对 克制

sentence_examples.en: She denied that she had cheated on the test.
sentence_examples.zh: 她否认自己在考试中作弊。

sentence_examples.en: The guard denied him entry to the club.
sentence_examples.zh: 保安拒绝他进入俱乐部。

sentence_examples.en: He denied responsibility for the mistake.
sentence_examples.zh: 他否认对这起错误负责。

translations.translation: 离开 起程 出发 死亡 脱轨
离开

sentence_examples.zh: 这架飞机将于上午9点起飞。

sentence_examples.zh: 该项目已偏离原计划，需要进行修改。

sentence_examples.en: He departed this life last year.
sentence_examples.zh: 他去年去世了。

translations.translation: 部 司 局 处 系 部门 省

sentence_examples.en: She works in the marketing department.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在市场部工作。

sentence_examples.en: The department is located on the third floor.
sentence_examples.zh: 该部门在三楼。

sentence_examples.en: Our department will have a meeting tomorrow morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们部门明天上午将召开会议。

translations.translation: 离开 出发 起程 分歧

sentence_examples.en: What time is the departure to Paris?
sentence_examples.zh: 去巴黎的出发时间是什么时候？

sentence_examples.en: The departure board shows all on-time flights.
sentence_examples.zh: 起飞信息屏显示所有准时起飞的航班。

sentence_examples.en: There was a departure from the usual policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 这与以往的政策有明显的偏离。

translations.translation: 依靠 依赖 相信 指望

sentence_examples.en: It depends on the weather.
sentence_examples.zh: 这取决于天气。

sentence_examples.en: You can depend on me.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以信赖我。

sentence_examples.en: Children depend on their parents for support.
sentence_examples.zh: 孩子们依赖父母来获得支持。

translations.translation: 依靠的 依赖的 附属的 悬垂的
受经济援助者

sentence_examples.en: Children are dependent on their parents for care.
sentence_examples.zh: 孩子在照顾上依赖父母。

sentence_examples.en: The project's success is dependent on funding.
sentence_examples.zh: 项目的成功取决于资金。
